slices.title: chat loop: tighten-only semantic injection pass, optional withhold
slices.summary: Adds a prompt_injection language operation (injection_json on LanguageAnalysisResult) and a tighten-only semantic pass in model-gateway for external tool results: it can promote Clean to Flagged and never demote, runs under its own 2.5 s deadline with per-run caps, never runs on ZDR turns, and in enforce mode withholds external payloads. Mode comes from the org config_json with env defaults; adds docs/CONTENT_SAFETY.md.
test_commands: model-gateway tests: semantic_flag_promotes_clean_to_flagged, semantic_clean_never_demotes_a_deterministic_flag, classifier_manipulation_cannot_loosen_a_verdict, timeout_keeps_deterministic_and_counts, fail_mode_degraded_sets_read_only, per_run_call_cap, partial_coverage_is_not_a_clean_claim, enforce_withholds_external_but_not_org_internal_or_mcp, config_json_parse_failure_falls_back_to_env_default, a_zdr_turn_never_calls_the_injection_classifier (modelled on the existing ZDR classifier test in semantic_screening.rs)

slices.title: Connector scope on the run request, enforced server-side (code half)
slices.summary: Adds ConnectorScope to RunAgentRequest as connector_scope = 23 (N4), carried from the model-gateway as connectorScope (max 8 ids, deduplicated; typed refusal under ZDR, Space or a non-auto retrieval scope). The read path refuses any connection outside the scope, and scope ids are stored only in run metadata through the existing RecordRunContext path, never under ZDR. The proto change is additive; tag-diff evidence stands in for buf breaking (N2).
